tagline: Frameworks, protocols and UI kits for interfaces that an AI model renders at runtime inside your own app.
scope: It is about UI a model chooses or renders at runtime, not a design tool that generates static mockups.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: a pink model orb sends UI blocks (a card, a chart, a button row and a toggle field) onto an empty app panel, where they assemble, reshuffle into new layouts and fly home.
